en_title: The Witcher 4 and All CD Projekt's Upcoming Games Remain Multiplatform Despite PlayStation Marketing Deal, CD Projekt Boss Reassures
cn_title: CD Projekt负责人向玩家保证：尽管与PlayStation达成营销协议，《巫师4》及CD Projekt所有即将推出的游戏仍将登陆多个平台
opus_summary: CD Projekt联合首席执行官Michał Nowakowski表示，尽管公司与索尼互动娱乐达成合作，《巫师4》及其他即将推出的游戏仍将登陆多个平台。《巫师4》计划于2028年推出，登陆PC、PS5及XBOX Series X和S。

paragraphs.en: CD Projekt co-CEO Michał Nowakowski has reassured fans that The Witcher 4 remains a multiplatform game despite its PlayStation marketing deal with Sony.
paragraphs.cn: CD Projekt联席首席执行官Michał Nowakowski向粉丝保证，尽管与索尼达成了PlayStation营销协议，《巫师4》仍是一款多平台游戏。

paragraphs.en: Announced yesterday as part of CD Projekt’s latest financial results , the partnership with Sony Interactive Entertainment also covers its games on PlayStation and PlayStation Plus. CD Projekt said the deal “will support our business and financial outlook in this and future years.”
paragraphs.cn: 这项与索尼互动娱乐的合作关系于昨日作为CD Projekt最新财务业绩的一部分公布，也涵盖了其在PlayStation和PlayStation Plus上的游戏。CD Projekt表示，这项协议「将为我们今年及未来几年的业务和财务前景提供支持」。

paragraphs.en: While the terms of the deal remain undisclosed, it is expected that The Witcher 4 marketing will feature PS5 prominently, perhaps even exclusively, as GTA 6’s marketing has done with the “Plays Best on PS5” tagline.
paragraphs.cn: 尽管协议条款尚未公开，预计《巫师4》的营销活动将突出展示PS5，甚至可能只展示PS5，就像《GTA 6》的营销活动使用「在PS5上玩效果最佳」这一宣传语一样。

paragraphs.en: In a follow-up post on social media , Nowakowski insisted The Witcher 4, which is slated for PC, PS5, and Xbox Series X and S, remains a multiplatform release, as do all the games CD Projekt has in the works. That presumably means no exclusivity deal for Cyberpunk 2, not that anyone suspected one might be put in place.
paragraphs.cn: 在随后发布的一则社交媒体帖子中，Nowakowski坚称，计划登陆PC、PS5以及XBOX Series X和S的《巫师4》仍将是一款多平台发行的游戏，CD Projekt正在开发的所有游戏也都是如此。这大概意味着《赛博朋克2》不会有独占协议，尽管并没有人怀疑可能会有这样一份协议。

paragraphs.en: “We’re looking forward to our partnership with PlayStation! And just to be clear: The Witcher 4 and our other upcoming titles will remain multiplatform,” Nowakowski said.
paragraphs.cn: Nowakowski说：「我们期待与PlayStation的合作！为免有任何疑问：《巫师4》和我们即将推出的其他游戏仍将登陆多个平台。」

paragraphs.en: Already there is concern around The Witcher 4’s PlayStation marketing deal, following the debate around GTA 6’s “Plays Best on PS5” tagline. As we’ve reported, the Xbox Series X version of Rockstar’s epic has better performance than the PS5 version , which has caused some to say they feel misled.
paragraphs.cn: 继围绕《GTA 6》「在PS5上玩效果最佳」宣传语的争论之后，人们已经对《巫师4》的PlayStation营销协议产生了担忧。正如我们此前报道的，Rockstar这款史诗巨作的XBOX Series X版本性能优于PS5版本，这让一些人表示自己感觉受到了误导。

paragraphs.en: The Witcher 4 isn’t due out until 2028 so there’s a long time to go before we see the result of CD Projekt’s effort, but marketing is expected to ramp up significantly in the coming months. Excitement is building, and this week CD Projekt said it expects the leap between The Witcher 3 and 4 to be comparable to the one between GTA 5 and 6 .
paragraphs.cn: 《巫师4》要到2028年才会推出，因此距离我们看到CD Projekt努力的成果还有很长时间，不过预计营销活动将在未来几个月大幅加强。人们的期待正不断升温，CD Projekt本周表示，预计《巫师3》到《巫师4》的跨越将与《GTA 5》到《GTA 6》的跨越相当。

paragraphs.en: As of October 31, 2026, CD Projekt had 513 staff working on The Witcher 4, which is actually down slightly on the previous number reported three months earlier. The number of people working on Cyberpunk 2, however, has ramped up, from 184 to 199.
paragraphs.cn: 截至2026年10月31日，CD Projekt有513名员工参与《巫师4》的开发，实际上比三个月前公布的上一次人数略有下降。不过，参与《赛博朋克2》开发的人数从184人增加到了199人。

paragraphs.en: CD Projekt has a huge amount going on right now. The Witcher 3 expansion, Songs of the Past, launches next year, followed by The Witcher 4 in 2028. CD Projekt has an ambitious plan to release further The Witcher sequels hot on the heels of The Witcher 4 as part of a new trilogy of games. Then there’s Cyberpunk 2 to squeeze in there at some point, The Witcher remake, Project Hadar, and Project Sirius.
paragraphs.cn: CD Projekt目前有大量工作正在进行。《巫师3》资料片《旧时曲》将于明年推出，随后是2028年的《巫师4》。CD Projekt有一个雄心勃勃的计划，要在《巫师4》之后紧接着推出更多《巫师》续作，作为全新游戏三部曲的一部分。此外，还有《赛博朋克2》要在某个时候穿插推出，以及《巫师》重制版、《Project Hadar》和《Project Sirius》。
